answer: Each challenge binds its nonce and task parameters to a future drand quicknet round, using its threshold-BLS output only after publication. A sonnet-writing sybil swarm therefore cannot precompute valid answers offline. A short response horizon, rate-limited eligibility, and commit-reveal binding constrain replay and duplicate submissions; beacon unpredictability supplies freshness, while eligibility limits—not the beacon alone—raise the cost of canyon-scale identity farming.
